```java title="Java"

public final class Example {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        var result = HtmlToMarkdownRs.convert("<p>visible</p><div style=\"display:none\">secret hidden text</div><p>also visible</p>", ConversionOptions.builder().build());
        System.out.println(result);

}
```
